test.ui:
- Inertia 3 + React 19 + TypeScript in resources/js; Tailwind 4 with the shadcn/ui theme (resources/css/app.css).
- Pages are resources/js/pages/**/*.tsx, rendered with Inertia::render() or Route::inertia(). Signed-in pages use
  AppLayout (resources/js/layouts/app-layout.tsx) with breadcrumbs, like pages/dashboard.tsx.
- Use the shadcn/ui components in resources/js/components/ui (button, card, input, label, checkbox, dialog, badge,
  select, separator, skeleton, alert, ...), lucide-react icons, and components/heading.tsx and input-error.tsx.
  If a shadcn component is missing, add it as a new file in components/ui in the same style; no new UI libraries.
- Forms follow pages/auth/login.tsx (Inertia <Form>, InputError, disabled + spinner while processing).
- Add new signed-in pages to the sidebar: mainNavItems in resources/js/components/app-sidebar.tsx.
- TypeScript uses Wayfinder route helpers (@/routes, @/actions). After adding routes or controllers run
  `php artisan wayfinder:generate --with-form`, then `npm run types:check` and `npm run check`.
